PENSION = (me.get("age") or 0) >= 68
PAY = "pension day" if PENSION else "payday"
PAY_TO = "pension day" if PENSION else "payday"
CYCLE = "pension cycle" if PENSION else "pay cycle"
def day(s):
    d = datetime.date.fromisoformat(str(s)[:10])
    return f"{d.day} {d:%b}"
emit("pay_word", PAY, "text", "The day money comes in")
emit("pay_to", PAY_TO, "text", "The day money comes in")

price = float(§PRICE§)
ITEM = "§ITEM§"
a = kori.afford(price, ITEM)
opts = [{"text": o["text"]} for o in a.get("options") or [] if o.get("text")]
if a["safe"]["before"] > 0 and not a.get("partial_view"):      # nothing safe to spend, or only part of the money here: worked out fresh
    emit("price", a["amount"], "eur", "The price")
    emit("safe_before", a["safe"]["before"], "eur", "Safe to spend now")
    emit("safe_after", a["safe"]["after"], "eur", "Safe to spend after buying it")
    emit("per_day_before", a["per_day"]["before"], "eur_per_day", "Safe a day now")
    emit("per_day_after", a["per_day"]["after"], "eur_per_day", "Safe a day after buying it")
    emit("usual_per_day", a["usual_per_day"], "eur_per_day", "Your usual day")
    emit("next_payday", a["next_payday"], "date", "Next payday")
    emit("good", 1 if a["verdict"] == "yes" else 0, "count", "Keeps your usual pace")
    emit("short_by", a["short_by"], "eur", "More than safe to spend by")
    table("ways", opts or [{"text": a["headline"]}], "Other ways to get it")
    emit("ways", len(opts), "count", "Other ways")
    if a["verdict"] == "no":
        say(f"Not before {PAY} on {day(a['next_payday'])}: {eur(a['amount'])} for {ITEM} is **{eur(a['short_by'], True)}** more than your safe to spend.")
    else:
        say(f"Yes. {eur(a['amount'])} for {ITEM} takes you from {eur(a['per_day']['before'], True)} to **{eur(a['per_day']['after'], True)}** a day until {PAY} on {day(a['next_payday'])}, and your usual is {eur(a['usual_per_day'], True)} a day." if a["verdict"] == "yes" else f"It fits, but {eur(a['amount'])} for {ITEM} takes you from {eur(a['per_day']['before'], True)} to **{eur(a['per_day']['after'], True)}** a day until {PAY} on {day(a['next_payday'])}.
